Neutral displacement 0.295 -> 0.192. ROUND 2 (2026-11-15): stride crotch shredding NOT fixed. A pelvis reweight of the crotch web found no hip-weighted verts there (the web is already pelvis-weighted / sparse -- 0 verts within 0.08 of the crotch point), so the fold lives in the pelvis/hip weight-transition zone. The remaining proper fix is a crotch gusset (folded pleat with slack) or a corrective blendshape -- not attempted; FLAGGED. Armpits also tear at relaxed/stride (shoulder swing +-18-20 deg + spine twist 6 deg on chubby arms touching the torso). ShoulderR |x| 0.154 vs recorded 0.156. toon-man.note: Meshy web download, rigged locally with scripts/rig-mannequin.mjs (no Meshy API credits). REPAIRED 2026-11-15 (round 1): BOTH hands rebuilt as capsule hands (palm + knuckle bar + 4 finger capsules + thumb, boolean-unioned, re-rigged). The original left hand had SIX digits (thumb + 5 finger-tips) and the rig found no thumb, so both hands stayed rigid and the app retarget went degenerate (62 bad quaternions, hands crushed to nubs). The rebuild has exactly thumb + 4 fingers, valid palms, and the degenerate retarget is fixed (retargetBad 62 -> 0). REPAIRED 2026-11-15 (round 2): the round-1 hands DETACHED in the app posed view. Root cause, diagnosed with numbers: a differential wrist twist concentrated in the narrow wrist skin-weight blend ramp (+-0.015H), NOT a weight gap or a joint offset -- the capsule hands were built in the original Meshy hand's frame, so the wrist frameTurn was 31.7/35.1 deg at neutral and the stretched triangles (wristMaxEdge 0.158/0.155 m) became invisible ribbons. Fix: (1) arms re-posed in Blender to the mannequin reference (shoulder 15.1/15.7 deg, elbow 15.9/32.1 deg; arms now exactly at the reference dirs); (2) hands rebuilt in the REFERENCE frame (palm normal within ~10-12 deg of ref); (3) collar given 8 rings so the rig's wrist section finds verts; (4) the rig pipeline gained a position-only weld (the glTF exporter splits verts at boolean seams, fragmenting the hand -- the repo's own rig scripts do NOT have this weld, see report); (5) cut extended to the collar's proximal ring to remove a lateral flap and a jagged forearm tear (the forearm stump bulges in across at along -0.06 past the collar's taper). Result on the slimmed public GLB: retargetBad 0, wristPost 15.5/13.0 deg, wristMaxEdge 0.052/0.028, neutral maxDisp 0.155, hands attached in neutral/relaxed/stride/hand-raised, rest hands read as thumb + 4 fingers. KNOWN REMAINING ISSUES: (a) the collar's proximal end cap reads as a small flat cuff flange around the forearm at the wrist in the neutral view -- removing the cap destroys the mesh (the boolean needs closed solids; tried and reverted). (b) ShoulderR |x| is 0.152 vs recorded 0.223 -- the shoulder is derived from the armpit slice + chest-edge clamp, which move when the arms are re-posed, so the recorded value (original pose) no longer applies; the re-posed value is correct for the new pose. RESKINNED 2026-11-16: skin weights replaced with bone-heat weights (scripts/reskin-cast.mjs, skeleton kept), measured in the app over all 7 pose presets (visible tears: edges growing >2x and >1% of height). REBUILT 2026-11-16 from the original Meshy mesh (the capsule-hand repair is gone): scripts/rig-character.mjs (body by rig-mannequin, shoulders symmetrised, fingers by scripts/rig-hands.mjs, Blender automatic weights). 9 poses 672 -> 154 cm2; fist and point work.
